gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes naming the class of calculation a rigid inclusion design was arrived at by. These codes are used for the value of the analysisApproach property of the diggs:RIProgramBasis object. Distinct from designMethod, which names a specific published method and is meaningful only where this value is analytical_method - numerical analysis, personal experience and load testing each select no named method at all. Options drawn from the state-of-the-practice survey Han et al. (2025) reproduces (RI-DIGGS Technical Report Table 3-1, Figure 3-13).
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Analysis Approach Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The design was calculated using a published closed-form or semi-analytical method - for example the FHWA beam or strain-compatibility methods, BS 8006-1, EBGEO, CUR226 or the Nordic method - recorded in the design's designMethod.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Analytical method

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The design was calculated using a numerical method, most commonly finite-element or finite-difference analysis, rather than a published closed-form analytical method.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Numerical analysis

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The design was set by engineering judgment or precedent rather than an explicit analytical or numerical calculation.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Personal experience

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The design basis was established or verified by pre-production or proof load testing rather than by calculation alone.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Load testing
